question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abound
solution:
The correct answer is "**Flourish.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Abound" means to exist in large numbers.**

 
 
• Example: Animals abound in the forest.
 
 
 
• **"Flourish" means to thrive or prosper abundantly, which is synonymous with the word "abound".**
 
 
• Example: The garden is flourishing with all sorts of colorful flowers.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "flourish" is the appropriate synonym of the word "abound."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Increase"** means to become or make something larger in size, number, or degree. 
 
• **"Succeed" **means to achieve a desired aim or result.
 
• **"Adequate"** means satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity.
